protocol_checks.vulnerability_mechanism: Confirmed. The browser OIDC flow generated and sent a random OAuth state but accepted server.auth_response["code"][0] without comparing the returned state, permitting a forged callback to bind the signing flow to an attacker-controlled authorization response.
